proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ ι s X hX h
  have e : (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, X i := by
    ext ω
    simp [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [e]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum hX h
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 μ) → Set.Pairwise (↑s : Set ι) (fun i j => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ) → ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) μ = ∑ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) μ
